[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Wiley was born in 1830. He is the son of [[Glasgow-2824|Alexander Glasgow]] and [[Markel-547|Mary Unknown]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2824]] is assessed at 94% (proved). Willey appears with Alexander and Jeremiah in the 1850 Green Township household. The 1845 guardianship identifies Alexander W and Jeremiah as Margaret’s minor heirs, while Jeremiah’s death names Alexander as father; the sibling/father combination strongly supports Wiley if Alexander W is the same child.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare ages/names in original 1845 guardianship and 1850 census.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99B-JFKT?view=fullText&keywords=Alexander+Glasgow%2CAlexander%2CGlasgow&searchForm=advanced&lang=en https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L99B-JFKT?view=fullText&keywords=Alexander+Glasgow%2CAlexander%2CGlasgow&searchForm=advanced&lang=en]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
